strategy_notes.tiktok: 7-15 sek, rask hook i første 2 sek, undertekster alltid på, curiosity-drevet åpning
strategy_notes.instagram_reels: 15-30 sek, mer polert, fokus på saves og replays, lengre livsløp (70 dager)

posts.title: Curiosity Hook – Strømregning
posts.hook_text: Kan du gjette hva denne norske hytta koster å varme opp per måned?
posts.cta: Finn ut hva din bolig koster → link i bio
posts.veo_prompt: Close up of a Norwegian wooden house exterior at night in winter, single warm light in window, snow falling, mysterious cinematic mood, no text, 9:16 portrait format, slow push-in camera movement
posts.image_first_frame_prompt: A Norwegian wooden hytte at night in winter, single warm glowing window, snow falling gently, dark moody sky, photorealistic, cinematic

posts.title: Før/Etter – Kald vs Varm Bolig
posts.cta: Få din gratis energianalyse på boligeffekt.no
posts.veo_prompt: Split screen cinematic video: left side shows cold drafty Norwegian house interior with frost on windows, grey light, right side shows same room warm golden light, modern insulation visible, cozy Scandinavian interior, smooth transition between the two, 9:16 portrait format
posts.image_first_frame_prompt: Cold grey Norwegian living room interior with frost on windows, dim light, photorealistic, cinematic wide shot

posts.title: Drone – Norsk Boligfelt Vinter
posts.hook_text: Slik ser fremtidens norske nabolag ut.
posts.reveal_text: Alle husene her er energimerke A. Strøm fra solen. Varme fra bakken.
posts.veo_prompt: Aerial drone shot slowly rising above a Norwegian residential neighborhood in winter, snow on rooftops, morning golden hour light, peaceful Scandinavian suburb, cinematic, photorealistic, 9:16 portrait format
posts.image_first_frame_prompt: Aerial view of Norwegian residential neighborhood in winter, snow covered rooftops, golden morning light, photorealistic drone shot

posts.title: POV – Du Får Energimerke A
posts.hook_text: POV: du åpner postkassen og ser energimerke A for første gang
posts.reveal_text: Det tok 3 uker. Og nå sparer du 60 000 kr i året.
posts.veo_prompt: POV shot of hands opening a Norwegian mailbox, pulling out an official energy certificate document showing grade A, warm sunlight, shallow depth of field, cinematic close-up, 9:16 portrait format
posts.image_first_frame_prompt: Close up of a hand reaching toward a Norwegian residential mailbox, warm daylight, photorealistic, shallow depth of field

posts.title: Edutainment – Energiskala Forklart
posts.hook_text: Ingen forteller deg dette om energimerker.
posts.reveal_text: G koster deg 120 000 kr mer enn A – over 10 år. Det er en Tesla.
posts.cta: Sjekk hva ditt hus koster → boligeffekt.no
posts.veo_prompt: Cinematic slow pan across a Norwegian house facade in autumn, warm golden light, leaves falling, camera slowly reveals an energy label A on the front door, photorealistic, elegant, 9:16 portrait format
posts.image_first_frame_prompt: Norwegian house facade in autumn golden light, leaves on ground, photorealistic, cinematic, warm atmosphere

posts.title: Cinematic – Varm Stue Vintermorgon
posts.hook_text: Slik starter morgonen i et energimerke A-hus.
posts.reveal_text: 18 grader ute. 22 grader inne. Uten å tenke på strøm.
posts.cta: Gjør hjemmet ditt til dette → boligeffekt.no
